scope: Repairs keyboard reading and speech cancellation, rapid navigation backlog, and slow or verbose text-unit reading. This is a beta testing build.

topics.title: Concise reading at a shared position
details: Next, previous, read, current, and read current character, word, line, sentence, and paragraph commands speak the text without announcing the unit number or total first. Character navigation includes spoken spaces and new lines. Explicit Where am I document location reporting remains available.

Keyboard caret movement and spoken text-unit movement share the reading position, including crossing paragraph boundaries. Reading-unit spans are cached so repeated movement through long text does not rebuild the entire unit list every time.

topics.title: Keyboard reading remains audible
details: Fixed cursor acknowledgment processing that interrupted newly generated keyboard speech. Cursor-only updates now preserve line, word, and character feedback in documents, received email, Help, and What’s new.

Repeated keyboard reading callbacks are replaced by the latest callback. Windows integration checks cover Up/Down, Left/Right, Ctrl+arrows, Home/End, and Ctrl+Home/End across editable and read-only text, and verify that processing cursor updates does not stop speech.

topics.title: Rapid navigation without replaying skipped items
details: Queued keyboard actions are applied in order while intermediate speech is suppressed. Only the final navigation result is announced. Cursor updates and editable field changes are preserved, and Control discards pending feedback.

Batches are bounded to keep microphone processing responsive. Regression tests verify that six rapid arrows move through all six items but announce only the destination. Native Options controls retain immediate feedback replacement.

topics.title: Faster spoken text navigation
details: Complete text-unit reading commands in email, Help, web reading, and notes join documents in the fast recognition path, skipping the slower second dictation-model pass. Natural move/go-to next/previous aliases and read current unit commands use the shared parser.

Short spoken text navigation uses local feedback even with AI narration selected, avoiding online speech-generation delays. Full narration remains available through the selected synthesizer. Explicit document/email dictation mode keeps literal dictation handling. Live microphone latency and acoustic output still require beta testing on the user’s Windows machine.
